cases.prompt: I finished my CWP admin module. Help me release it as an open-source project on GitHub.
expectations: Recommends running a security review (cwp-security-review) as a gate before releasing
Provides or points to install.sh/uninstall.sh that are idempotent, support --dry-run and keep existing config
Proposes CI with shellcheck, php -l and bats, and a release workflow that takes notes from CHANGELOG
Mentions SemVer with Keep a Changelog, SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, issue templates and branch protection
Does not commit, tag or push without being asked

cases.prompt: I develop on Windows and my GitHub Actions run fails with 'Permission denied' on install.sh and tests. What is wrong?
expectations: Identifies that files committed from Windows are mode 100644
Gives git update-index --chmod=+x for each script and a way to verify with git ls-files --stage
Suggests .gitattributes with eol=lf for *.sh and a CI step that checks executable bits

cases.prompt: Write the installer for my CWP module. /usr/local/cwpsrv/htdocs/admin is immutable and CWP updates keep removing my menu entry.
expectations: Uses chattr -i only on directories it writes into, via find -xdev ! -type l -exec chattr -i {} +, and restores the lock afterwards (trap)
Appends the menu <li> to resources/admin/include/3rdparty.php only if absent, creating the file when missing
Adds a self-heal mode (install.sh --heal) plus a cron job that re-applies module files and menu without touching config
Installer supports --dry-run and is shellcheck-clean at all severities, never uses curl | bash

cases.prompt: How do I announce my module on the CWP forum and get it into the CWP developer programme?
expectations: Describes a factual forum post (what it does, tested versions, install with checksum, uninstall, support channel)
Says to verify the current developer programme requirements with the CWP team or docs and does not invent an approval process
Warns not to claim official or certified status and to redact hostnames, IPs and accounts in posts
